items.label: Elegant Watch for Women
items.value: This women's watch boasts a dainty & vintage design with a sleek delicate gold-tone plated case. A minimalist clean sunray dial with 3-hand analog. It’s a perfect accessory for any outfit. This waterproof gold watch brings a retro touch to your look.

items.label: Comfortable & Premium
items.value: This vintage watch features a genuine slim brown leather band bracelet, comfortable and lightweight to wear. The adjustable strap ensures a perfect fit. Powered by imported Japanese quartz movement, this gold oval watch has reliable timekeeping.

items.label: Size
items.value: 20*25mm (0.79*0.98") diameter case, 8mm (0.32") thin case thickness, 12mm (0.47") band width, 195mm (7.68") band length. This watch is suitable for small or medium size women wrists, making you feel just right without being bulky.

items.label: Perfect Choice for Her
items.value: This gold watch is an ideal choice for women with elegance and quality, making it an ideal gift for birthdays, parties, anniversaries, weddings, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Christmas and other special occasions for your family and friends.

items.label: 30M Waterproof
items.value: Water resistant to rain, hand washing, splash, brief immersion in water, offering reliable performance for everyday use. Avoid pressing any buttons while in water to maintain optimal functionality.
